name: azula
description: Reach your OpenClaw bot from your phone over azula's end-to-end iroh transport, instead of through a third-party messenger.

enabled.description: Whether this azula channel is active.

device.description: The azula device to talk to, by the name it has in `azula devices`. Leave it unset to pair a phone: the account then waits for one (`openclaw channels login --channel azula` shows the invite) and saves the device here once it has paired. A device that is set must already be paired with this account's session.

configWrites.description: Whether the channel may write the device a phone paired as into this config. Turn it off to keep the config read-only: the account still serves the phone, and `channels status` shows the exact `openclaw config set` line that would save it.

binary.description: Path to the azula binary. Leave unset to use `azula` from PATH.

session.description: azula session name. Persistent, so the conversation on the phone survives gateway restarts rather than appearing anew each time. Give each account its own name — two accounts sharing one would fight over the same session key.

label.description: Conversation title shown on the phone.

dmPolicy.description: Reserved for parity with other channels. azula's own device pairing is the real access boundary: only a paired device can reach this machine at all.

accounts.description: Additional named accounts, each addressing its own device. Fields omitted here inherit from the root.
